general.subtitle: Application behavior and default display
general.launchDesc: Open automatically when you sign in to your computer
general.backgroundDesc: Start minimized so mining can run without a window
general.title: General
general.closeActionDesc: What happens when you close the window
general.closeTrayHint: CointMU keeps running in the tray. Choose Quit in the tray menu to exit.
general.confirmQuitDesc: Confirm when you quit while mining or syncing. Never asked for updates or when the computer shuts down.
general.chainDataPickTitle: Choose a folder for the chain data
general.chainDataConfirmBody: The node and mining stop while the data is copied, then start from the new folder. The target needs {{size}} free. Your current data stays until you delete it.
general.chainDataMovedBody: The node now runs from the new folder. The old copy ({{size}}) is still on disk:

chainDataError.INSIDE_CURRENT: Pick a folder outside the current chain data folder.
chainDataError.NOT_EMPTY: Pick an empty or new folder.
chainDataError.NOT_WRITABLE: CointMU cannot write to that folder.
chainDataError.NOT_ENOUGH_SPACE: Not enough free space on that drive.
chainDataError.COPY_FAILED: Copying failed. The node keeps using the current folder; nothing was lost.
chainDataError.VERIFY_FAILED: The copy did not match. The node keeps using the current folder; nothing was lost.
chainDataError.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. The chain data was not moved.

general.logsDesc: App and node logs on this computer
general.diagnosticsDesc: A ZIP with the logs, versions and settings, for a bug report. Keys, keystores and the recovery phrase are never included.
general.diagnosticsFailed: The bundle could not be saved.
general.autoCheckDesc: Look for a new version when CointMU starts. You can always check in About.
general.installModeDesc: The node always shuts down cleanly before an update installs.

connectedSites.title: Connected Sites
connectedSites.description: These third-party applications have been granted read-only access to your active wallet address, network state, and chain data. They can interact with your wallet without triggering the approval modal for standard reads.
connectedSites.emptyDesc: No external applications are currently connected to your CointMU wallet.
connectedSites.statusConnectedDesc: The browser extension is linked and bridging requests.
connectedSites.statusDisconnectedDesc: The browser extension is not currently linked.

externalSources.title: External Sources
externalSources.description: Manage integrations and standalone companions for your CointMU wallet.
externalSources.extensionDesc: This standalone extension bridges external dApps to your desktop node. Download the bundled ZIP file and load it unpacked into your browser to enable Web3 connectivity.
externalSources.exportFailed: Could not save the extension ZIP. Try another folder; if it keeps failing, report an issue with the logs.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.openDataDesc: Reveal the datadir in your file explorer
advanced.purgeWalletsConfirm: Are you sure? This will delete all non-primary accounts from this device.

resetModal.title: Reset to Default Settings

networkSettings.subtitle: Network, peers, sync, and bootnodes
networkSettings.networkDesc: Which chain CointMU is connected to
networkSettings.maxPeersDesc: Upper bound on simultaneous peer connections
networkSettings.listenPortDesc: UDP / TCP port used by the gossip protocol

bootnodes.title: CointMU nodes
bootnodes.desc: Your node connects to every node that is on and keeps reconnecting, so each one backs up the others. Each is also a bootnode for finding more peers.
bootnodes.autoCheck: Checked every {{seconds}} s while this page is open.
bootnodes.addHint: Up to 10 nodes in all. A new node is connected right away, without a restart.
bootnodes.restartPending: A node you removed or turned off stays a bootnode until the node restarts.
bootnodes.warning: Only enter enodes you received from the CointMU admins. A bootnode from anyone else can connect you to fake peers and show you a false view of the network.
bootnodes.requestFailed: Could not update the node list. Your previous setting is still in use.

errors.INVALID_ENODE: Not a valid enode (enode://<128-hex public key>@<host>:<port>).
errors.EMPTY: Keep at least one node on.
errors.TOO_MANY: Too many nodes. The list holds at most 10.
errors.DUPLICATE: This node is already in the list.
errors.INVALID_LABEL: Use a label of up to 40 characters on one line.

notice.added: Node added. Your node is connecting to it now.

miningSettings.subtitle: Manage internal node mining behavior
miningSettings.enableDesc: Allow this client to solve block hashes
miningSettings.cpuThreadsDesc: Maximum cores used for hashing ({{count}}/{{max}} allocated)
miningSettings.pauseDesc: Stop mining when laptop is disconnected from power
miningSettings.rewardAddressDesc: Where coinbase rewards are sent (defaults to main wallet)

securitySettings.subtitle: Manage security settings for your wallet
securitySettings.autoLockDesc: Lock keys after 5 minutes of inactivity
securitySettings.seedPhraseDesc: 12-word seed used to restore your wallet
securitySettings.privateKeyDesc: Decrypt and display the raw private key for an account
securitySettings.resetWalletDesc: Removes all accounts and keys from this device. Cannot be undone.

privacy.title: Privacy & Diagnostics
privacy.subtitle: Error reports and local logs
privacy.notConfigured: Error reporting is not configured in this build. Nothing is sent; logs are still saved on this computer.
privacy.toggleDesc: Sends sanitized error reports to the CointMU server at {{host}}, reachable only on the campus network. Off deletes reports that have not been sent yet.
privacy.sendingOff: Nothing is sent while error reporting is off.
privacy.sendingHeld: Reports wait on this computer until you close the error reporting notice.

sent.stack: Stack trace, with your user name removed from file paths
sent.versions: App, Electron and operating system versions
sent.node: Node failure category and recovery stage

neverSent.secrets: Passwords, recovery phrases, private keys, signed transactions
neverSent.identity: IP addresses, user name, computer name

queue.title: Waiting to be sent ({{count}})
queue.empty: No reports are waiting to be sent.
queue.loadFailed: Could not read the report queue.

privacy.logsDesc: Logs are saved on this computer (sanitized) and are never sent automatically. Attach them when you report a problem.

notice.title: Error reports help us fix CointMU
notice.what: When something goes wrong, CointMU saves a report with the error, a stack trace, and app and system versions. Passwords, recovery phrases, private keys, wallet addresses, IP addresses and your user name are removed first.
notice.where: Reports are sent to the CointMU server at {{host}}, which is reachable only on the campus network. Off campus they wait on this computer and are sent later.
notice.howToDisable: You can turn this off at any time in Settings → Privacy & Diagnostics.

recoveryPhraseModal.description: Your 12-word seed phrase restores full access to this wallet.
recoveryPhraseModal.warning: Never share your recovery phrase. Anyone who has it can take full control of your wallet and steal all of your funds. Store it offline and never type it into a website.
recoveryPhraseModal.autoHide: This phrase will be hidden automatically in {{seconds}}s.

revealKeyModal.description: Decrypt and display the raw private key for one of your accounts.
revealKeyModal.warning: Never share your private key. Anyone who has it gains full control of this account and can steal all of its funds. CointMU support will never ask for it.
revealKeyModal.autoHide: This key will be hidden automatically in {{seconds}}s.

exportKeystoreModal.description: Save an encrypted JSON keystore for your active account. You can import it into other wallets using this same password.

resetWalletModal.description: This permanently removes all accounts and keys from this device.
resetWalletModal.warning: This action is irreversible. If you have not backed up your recovery phrase or private keys, your funds will be lost forever. CointMU cannot recover them for you.
